apps.localizedDescription: An experimental, fully on-device iPhone app for backing up selected photos, videos, and albums to Google Photos.

versions.localizedDescription:
### What's new

- **Backup filters & limits (#14, #23, #32):**
  - **Media Types** (`Settings → Backup`): choose **Photos & Videos**, **Photos Only**, or **Videos Only** across selected albums and picked folders.
  - **Only Back Up After Date** (`Settings → Backup`): back up only items created on or after a chosen date/time, with a quick **Set to Now** button.
  - **Only While Charging**, **Minimum Battery**, and **Daily Upload Limit** (500 MB–10 GB/day, counting only bytes actually uploaded — duplicates already in Google Photos don't count — and resuming automatically the next day).
- **Edited photo originals (#33):** Opt-in **Back Up Edited Photo Originals** toggle under `Settings → Backup` to upload the unedited original alongside the edited version (and backfill originals for edited photos already backed up).
- **Export / Import Backup History (#34):** Save or restore a privacy-safe JSON archive of backed-up item records and Google album links under `Settings → Support → Storage` (no credentials or media), so reinstalling or switching signing certificates doesn't require re-checking your whole library.
- **Background backup improvements (#47):**
  - Added `BGAppRefreshTask` scheduling alongside `BGProcessingTask` for more frequent background discovery.
  - Decoupled background `URLSession` transfer handoff (up to 8 concurrent transfers with a 512 MB staging budget while keeping local export/hashing at 2).
  - Moved PhotoKit library change scans off the main thread so background expiry and UI turns stay responsive.
  - Opt-in **Wake on Location Change** (`Settings → Background`, requires Always location permission) to wake and discover new photos when travelling or arriving home; coordinates are ignored.

### Install
- SideStore / AltStore / Feather source: `https://g8row.github.io/PhotosBackup/apps.json`
- Or download `PhotosBackup.ipa` (built by GitHub Actions from this tag, verified by `PhotosBackup.ipa.sha256`) once the release workflow finishes attaching it.
